Backup & export

Export everything as a JSON file you can store or move to another device.
Import a previously exported JSON file — merge with or replace current entries.
Monthly report — a printable one-page summary. Your browser's print dialog can save it as a PDF.
P&L card photos — background images for your shareable cards. A random one is picked each time you open a card.
Storage used — screenshots are stored inside this browser, and the ceiling is roughly 5 MB.
Sync between devices — keeps this app identical on your Mac and iPhone through your private GitHub repo. Add or edit on either one.
Not set up on this device yet.
Install as an app — runs in its own window, no browser chrome, works offline.
Display scale — sizes the whole interface. Everything scales together.
18px
Danger zone — permanently wipes every manual entry, checklist item, goal, achievement, bias call, and saved preference in this browser. This cannot be undone. Export a backup first if you want to keep a copy.
